title: Extension of a relation
statement: Let $R$ be a relation on finite Boolean lists, let $m$ be a natural number, and let $y$ and $p$ be Boolean lists. Say that $p$ extends to an $R$-related list of length $m$ relative to $y$ if there is a Boolean list $s$ such that $p$ followed by $s$ has length $m$ and is related to $y$ by $R$.
